open_points.subject: project-create replay after anonymisation
open_points.text: A01 rule 8 says a create after anonymisation with the former request id “is a new create, answered with the new record it made”; the changed R0-36 context likewise says it “is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made.” But as a new create it is subject to the ordinary refusal of a customer reference that has since become erased, restricted or ended, whereas A01 rule 3 bypasses that eligibility check only for a recognised repeat.
open_points.question: After anonymisation removes the request id, must the resubmitted project create always make a new project, or is it an ordinary new create that can be refused because its formerly valid customer is now ineligible?
options: Always create and return the new project despite the customer's current state
Apply all ordinary create checks and refuse when the customer is now erased, restricted or ended
open_points.default_guess: Apply all ordinary checks because the request is classified as a new create.

witness.initial: Project P was created with request id K and names eligible Customer C.
events: The owner archives and anonymises P, removing P's request id and customer link.
The owner resubmits the original create-project request with K and the same facts, including customer_ref C.
outcomes: A01 rule 8 and changed R0-36 make and return a new project.
The ordinary project-create eligibility rule refuses the request because C is restricted, and no project is made.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a new project in the catalogue or a refusal.

open_points.subject: re-upload replacing a file after import confirmation was shown
open_points.text: The changed concurrency review names “re-uploads replacing a confirmed file.” A16 says another upload replaces the kept file “one of the same bytes included” and requires an old confirmation to be refused “also when the new file has the same bytes,” while A13 binds the confirmation to the file only by its digest and M11 carries no upload identity or generation.
open_points.question: When the owner re-uploads byte-for-byte identical content after the import confirmation step was shown, is the existing confirmation still valid, and what recorded fact distinguishes the replacement from the original upload?
options: Accept the existing confirmation because the current file and bound digest are identical
Refuse the existing confirmation after every successful re-upload, including identical bytes
open_points.default_guess: Refuse it, following A16's explicit required test.

witness.initial: An owner session holds import file F; Registry has shown a confirmation value Q bound to digest D, the picks and the mapping inputs.
events: The owner uploads F again with exactly the same bytes, so the current file also has digest D.
The owner submits Q with the unchanged picks and mapping inputs.
outcomes: A16's required test refuses the submission because the file confirmed earlier was replaced.
A13's binding checks all pass because Q remains pending and the current file, picks and inputs have exactly the bound digest and values, so the import is accepted.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a refused confirmation requiring a new step or a committed import.
